measurementTrap.observed: An immediate read straight after clicking Delete reported the dialog still present in the DOM (dialogStillOpen: true).
measurementTrap.diagnosis: Exit animation still in flight at the instant of the read, not a stuck dialog. A probe one round later found no dialog node at all, and finishing every running animation changed nothing.
measurementTrap.rule: This is automated-tab-freezes-animations-and-wipes-storage seen from the other side: read dialog teardown after the animation, never at the instant of the click.
